description: Encode coordinates as an Open Location Code (plus code) at a chosen length, or decode a full code back to its bounding box and centre. Also shortens a full code against a reference coordinate and recovers a shortened code given a reference, which is how plus codes are normally exchanged in text. Returns code length, precision in metres and validity. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

code.description: Plus code for decode, shorten or recover. Accepted: at most 20 characters.

lat.description: Latitude for op=encode. Accepted: a number between -90 and 90.

length.description: Integer code length for op=encode: one of 2,4,6,8,10 (default),11,12,13,14,15. Other integers in 2-15 are 400 UNSUPPORTED_VALUE. Accepted: one of 2,4,6,8,10,11,12,13,14,15.

lon.description: Longitude for op=encode. Accepted: a number between -180 and 180.

op.description: encode (default), decode, shorten or recover. Accepted: encode, decode, shorten, recover.

ref_lat.description: Reference latitude for op=shorten/recover. Accepted: a number between -90 and 90.

ref_lon.description: Reference longitude for op=shorten/recover. Accepted: a number between -180 and 180.

name: geo_pluscode
title: Open Location Code (plus code) encode and decode
